# thousandeyes_user (Resource)

Retrieve user.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) User's email address.
- `name` (String) User's display name.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `all_account_group_roles` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--all_account_group_roles))
- `date_registered` (String) UTC date the user registered their account (ISO date-time format).
- `id` (String) Unique ID of the user. Named `id` per the import convention; the wire field stays uid.
- `last_login` (String) UTC last login of the user (ISO date-time format).
- `login_account_group` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--login_account_group))
